title: Ultimate Tribute to the 'All New' Mickey Mouse Club!
description:
Once in the Club… Always In The Club: The True Story of The ‘All New’ Mickey Mouse Club

A Limited Edition Collector’s Coffee Table Book Honoring the Legacy of the ’90s Mickey Mouse Club

Step into the world of the "All New Mickey Mouse Club" with this stunning collector’s coffee table book, a one-of-a-kind tribute to the show that defined a generation.

heroImage.alt: Ultimate Tribute to the 'All New' Mickey Mouse Club!

blocks.html: On April 24, 1989, the 'All New' Mickey Mouse Club premiered, sparking a cultural phenomenon that continues to inspire generations. Now, 36 years later, we’re thrilled to announce the release of a unique collector’s item: "Always In The Club: The True Story of the 'All New' Mickey Mouse Club."

This Limited Edition, Numbered Commemorative Coffee Table Book is a stunning piece of art that celebrates the magic, memories, and cultural impact of the '90s MMC. It features exclusive behind-the-scenes stories, rare photos, and personal reflections from cast members, their parents, crew, and fans. This book is more than just a keepsake—it’s a historical record of a show that shaped pop culture and launched the careers of global superstars.
Also available are the Paperback, Hardcover, and Master Digital Archive editions.

blocks.text: What’s Inside? A Celebration of The 'All New' Mickey Mouse Club!

blocks.html: Comprehensive Episode Guides for all seven seasons, highlighting fan-favorite moments and iconic guest appearances, such as Michael Jackson, New Kids on the Block, and Whitney Houston.
Behind-the-Scenes Photos: Rare, never-before-seen images from the set and while on tour with The Party.
Fan Stories: Personal memories and photos submitted by YOU, the fans who grew up with MMC.
Mouseketeer & Crew Reflections: Untold stories and candid moments from cast members, their families, and crew.
Pre-order today to secure your limited edition and numbered copy. It comes complete with:
YOUR NAME on a special dedication page.
A certificate of authenticity signed by contributing Mouseketeers.
Exclusive bonuses like a commemorative bookmark, button pin, and access to the virtual book release party.
Exclusive Club Member perks, including a rebate on membership dues and exclusive merch!

A portion of the proceeds will support the Always In The Club Foundation. This foundation ensures MMC’s legacy continues through mentorship, arts education, and philanthropy. By purchasing this book, you’re not only preserving the legacy of MMC but also empowering future generations. This initiative inspires them to envision bold dreams and reach their fullest potential.
This is YOUR moment to own a piece of MMC history. Visit our website to learn more and to submit YOUR memories of MMC. Limited copies are available, so act fast!
JOIN THE WAITING LIST for Your Copy Today!

Being part of the MMC community means joining others who share a deep appreciation for this iconic show. Join us in celebrating milestones and creating new memories as we relive the magic of the Mickey Mouse Club together. 🎉✨

Whether you're a longtime fan or discovering MMC for the first time, this book is a treasure trove of nostalgia. Get ready to dive into the stories, the excitement, and the joy that the 'All New' Mickey Mouse Club brought into the lives of so many.
Let’s make new memories while cherishing the old ones. Don’t let this opportunity slip away!
